sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日简报 DealBook 的商业与政策报道。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市的 DealBook 峰会上，

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zilran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 在现场采访一些商界、政界和文化界举足轻重的领袖，包括 J.D. 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼等众多嘉宾。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经过滤的实时对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch, free, at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在 nytimes.com 上进行部分访谈的现场直播，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订户，可以下载《纽约时报》App进行观看，并免费获得我们所有新闻内容一个月的访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today, inside Hong Kong's airport, thousands of protesters are trying to send a message to the people of mainland China.
sentences.zh: 今天，在香港机场内部，成千上万的示威者正试图向中国大陆人民传递一个信息。

sentences.en: What the people of mainland China are making of that message, it's Wednesday, August 14th.
sentences.zh: 而中国大陆人民对这个信息作何感想，今天是8月14日，星期三。

sentences.en: Javier Hernandez, how did you come to be at the airport in Hong Kong on Monday?
sentences.zh: 哈维尔·埃尔南德斯，你周一怎么会去香港机场的？

sentences.en: Well, I'm a Beijing correspondent for the Times, and I had been in Hong Kong for several days reporting on these protests as they reached this breaking point.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我是《时报》的北京记者，我在香港待了好几天，报道这些抗议活动达到这个爆发点。

sentences.en: So I was headed home.
sentences.zh: 所以我当时正准备回家。

sentences.en: I had packed my bags.
sentences.zh: 我收拾好了行李。

sentences.en: I had headed to the airport.
sentences.zh: 我前往了机场。

sentences.en: And then suddenly my phone just started buzzing with alerts.
sentences.zh: 然后突然我的手机就开始不停地震动，弹出各种提醒。

sentences.en: And I looked down, and there were all these reports about mass chaos at the airport, about flights being canceled, about protesters kind of taking over the terminal.
sentences.zh: 我低头一看，全都是关于机场发生严重混乱、航班被取消、示威者几乎占领航站楼的报道。

sentences.en: So I hopped on the train and headed out there.
sentences.zh: 所以我跳上地铁赶了过去。

sentences.en: Already on the train, you could sort of sense this intense sense of unreSt.
sentences.zh: 在地铁上，你就能隐约感觉到那种强烈的动荡不安。

sentences.en: There were protesters just filling up the cars.
sentences.zh: 车厢里挤满了示威者。

sentences.en: They're all wearing their black T-shirts, which is kind of a signature of this movement.
sentences.zh: 他们都穿着黑色T恤，这可以说是这场运动的标志。

sentences.en: You could sense the protest was building.
sentences.zh: 你能感觉到抗议正在酝酿升级。

sentences.en: Airport.
sentences.zh: 机场。

sentences.en: Doors were open on the left for Terminal 1.
sentences.zh: 一号航站楼左侧车门已打开。

sentences.en: And on the right for Terminal 2.
sentences.zh: 二号航站楼右侧车门已打开。

sentences.en: So I get off the train.
sentences.zh: 于是我下了车。

sentences.en: I'm here in the main arrivals hall of the Hong Kong airport, and there's a crowd of people just sitting here.
sentences.zh: 我来到了香港机场的主到达大厅，这里坐满了人群。

sentences.en: They break into cheers.
sentences.zh: 他们爆发出一阵欢呼。

sentences.en: It's usually this dull place, you know, where you just see a lot of businessmen and other people lining up in the first-class lounges.
sentences.zh: 这里通常是个沉闷的地方，你知道的，只能看到许多商界人士和其他人在头等舱休息室外排队。

sentences.en: But on this day, you know, you look out and you just see a sea of people.
sentences.zh: 但在这一天，放眼望去，你只能看到人山人海。

sentences.en: There was just no space to move at all.
sentences.zh: 根本连移动的空间都没有。

sentences.en: It was really just a sense of chaos and not knowing what might happen.
sentences.zh: 那种感觉真的是一片混乱，而且不知道会发生什么。

sentences.en: So I walked in, you know, thinking still that I could maybe catch my flight.
sentences.zh: 所以我走了进去，当时还想着或许能赶上我的航班。

sentences.en: So I ran up to the departures hall, and it quickly became clear that that wasn't going to be possible.
sentences.zh: 于是我跑向出发大厅，但很快就很清楚，那是不可能的了。

sentences.en: There were people kind of blocking the way to the departures hall.
sentences.zh: 有人挡住了通往出发大厅的路。

sentences.en: People had thrown up these luggage carts to use as a barrier in some cases to stop people from getting through.
sentences.zh: 有些情况下，人们甚至搬出行李推车当做路障，阻止人们通过。

sentences.en: I looked on the walls, and there was graffiti, various slogans from the protesters.
sentences.zh: 我看着墙壁，上面有涂鸦，以及示威者的各种标语。

sentences.en: You could start to hear announcements from the airlines saying there are no flights going, it's not safe, people should just leave.
sentences.zh: 你开始听到各大航空公司的广播，说没有航班起飞了，这里不安全，大家应该马上离开。

sentences.en: So it felt like really that the protesters had taken over.
sentences.zh: 所以感觉真的是示威者已经接管了这里。

sentences.en: There were taping signs to the floor, portraits of protesters, and anti-police slogans.
sentences.zh: 有人用胶带将标语贴在地板上，上面有示威者的画像和反警察的口号。

sentences.en: So these protesters have essentially shut down the airport.
sentences.zh: 所以这些示威者基本上已经让机场瘫痪了。

sentences.en: They shut it down, and very quickly.
sentences.zh: 他们让机场陷入瘫痪，而且速度非常快。

sentences.en: And Javier, why the airport?
sentences.zh: 哈维尔，为什么选在机场？

sentences.en: What's the significance of that as a location for these protesters?
sentences.zh: 对这些抗议者来说，这个地点有什么重要意义？

sentences.en: Well, I think it's an icon of Hong Kong.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为这是香港的一个标志。

sentences.en: Hong Kong is such a global financial center.
sentences.zh: 香港是一个极其重要的全球金融中心。

sentences.en: And in Asia in particular, Hong Kong is kind of this hub for everything.
sentences.zh: 尤其在亚洲，香港可以说是各方交汇的枢纽。

sentences.en: And so they knew that if they occupied this airport, if they were successful in stopping people from passing through,
sentences.zh: 因此他们知道，如果占领这个机场，如果成功阻止人们通行，

sentences.en: they could not only attract a lot of attention in the news media, but they could also reach a lot of people who might end up passing through the airport.
sentences.zh: 他们不仅能在新闻媒体上吸引大量关注，还能接触到许多最终途径机场的人。

sentences.en: You can imagine people who were bleary-eyed from their long trips from New York, landing suddenly in Hong Kong and coming out to this sea of protesters, chanting and holding signs.
sentences.zh: 你可以想象，那些从纽约经历漫长旅程、双眼布满血丝的人，突然降落在香港，走出来却面对着这一片人山人海、高喊口号并举着标语的抗议者。

sentences.en: And part of that increasingly is also to talk to people from China.
sentences.zh: 而这其中越来越重要的一部分，也是为了与来自中国的人们对话。

sentences.en: Every day, there are so many visitors from the mainland who come to Hong Kong.
sentences.zh: 每天都有大量来自大陆的游客来到香港。

sentences.en: And this is an opportunity for these young protesters to speak directly to people in the mainland, to counter Beijing's propaganda machine.
sentences.zh: 这对这些年轻抗议者来说是一个直接向大陆民众对话、对抗北京宣传机器的机会。

sentences.en: So this is a rare opportunity for these protesters in Hong Kong to talk directly to mainland China, where a lot of information doesn't get through.
sentences.zh: 所以对香港的这些抗议者来说，这是一个难得的机会，可以直接与信息很难完全传达进去的中国大陆进行交流。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 的确如此。

sentences.en: And it really comes as the mainland has been trying to portray Hong Kong as a place of kind of spoiled brats in many ways.
sentences.zh: 这确实发生在大陆一直试图将香港描绘成一群被宠坏的“小祖宗”的背景之下。

sentences.en: They feel like Hong Kong has benefited a lot from its association with mainland China, that China has invested in infrastructure.
sentences.zh: 他们觉得香港从与中国大陆的联系中受益匪浅，中国在基础设施上进行了投资。

sentences.en: China has helped build its financial system.
sentences.zh: 中国协助构建了它的金融体系。

sentences.en: And so when they look at Hong Kong these days, they feel like, why are you protesting?
sentences.zh: 所以当他们如今看着香港时，他们会觉得，你们到底在抗议什么？

sentences.en: What more could you ever want?
sentences.zh: 你们还能想要更多什么？

sentences.en: And it really goes to this fundamental contradiction, I think, between the mainland and Hong Kong.
sentences.zh: 我认为，这实际上触及了大陆与香港之间这种根本性的矛盾。

sentences.en: In the mainland, the economy is central, and people consider economic success to equate with happiness.
sentences.zh: 在大陆，经济是核心，人们认为经济成功就等同于幸福。

sentences.en: In Hong Kong, I think it's much more complicated, much more like a Western society, where money is obviously extremely important, but people also want a bit more than that.
sentences.zh: 而在香港，我认为情况要复杂得多，更像西方社会，金钱固然极其重要，但人们也渴望更多别的东西。

sentences.en: And so you see this kind of collision course that these two different societies are on.
sentences.zh: 因此你可以看到这两个不同社会正走在某种碰撞的轨道上。

sentences.en: One that believes in stability and economic prosperity, and the other that's looking more for a voice and a seat at the table.
sentences.zh: 一个信仰稳定与经济繁荣，另一个则更渴望拥有发言权和决策席位。

sentences.en: When you talk to these protesters, the first thing they'll tell you is, we don't want to turn into the mainland.
sentences.zh: 当你与这些抗议者交谈时，他们对你说的第一件事就是：我们不想变成大陆。

sentences.en: We want to be special.
sentences.zh: 我们要保持特殊。

sentences.en: We don't want courts that are controlled by the Communist Party.
sentences.zh: 我们不想要由共产党控制的法院。

sentences.en: We don't want a press that has no ability to criticize the government.
sentences.zh: 我们不想要一个没有能力批评政府的新闻界。

sentences.en: And so when you sit in the airport and kind of listen, what you're hearing really, I think, is this passionate defense of democracy.
sentences.zh: 所以当你坐在机场倾听时，我认为你真正听到的，是对民主充满热情的捍卫。

sentences.en: And what these Hong Kong people want the world to understand is that they are going to stand up and prevent any kind of effort by the mainland
sentences.zh: 香港人希望全世界理解的是，他们将挺身而出，阻止大陆方面的任何企图，

sentences.en: to turn Hong Kong into another Chinese city.
sentences.zh: 把香港变成又一个中国普通城市。

sentences.en: And Javier, from what you're seeing through this admittedly limited window at the airport, are the protesters able to get through to mainland Chinese with that message?
sentences.zh: 哈维尔，从你透过机场这个不可否认具有局限性的窗口所看到的情况来看，抗议者们能够将这个信息传达给中国大陆人吗？

sentences.en: I think it's really tough for them.
sentences.zh: 我认为这对他们来说真的很难。

sentences.en: And it mostly falls on deaf ears.
sentences.zh: 而且大多都如对牛弹琴。

sentences.en: What do the mainlanders say when you...
sentences.zh: 大陆人都是怎么说的，当你...

sentences.en: Ask for the democracy?
sentences.zh: 要求民主时？

sentences.en: They have the question mark over their head.
sentences.zh: 他们脑子里顶着个大大的问号。

sentences.en: What is democracy?
sentences.zh: 什么是民主？

sentences.en: Are their faces, like, disagree with what you say?
sentences.zh: 他们的表情，是不是不同意你所说的话？

sentences.en: I was talking to a young woman today.
sentences.zh: 我今天采访了一位年轻女性。

sentences.en: She had been staying there all day at the arrivals hall with the explicit goal of trying to get through to mainlanders.
sentences.zh: 她一整天都待在到达大厅里，明确的目的就是试图与大陆人沟通。

sentences.en: And she told me that she really felt like it wasn't successful, that people would just walk by.
sentences.zh: 她告诉我，她真的觉得自己没有成功，人们只是从她身边走过。

sentences.en: There was a guy who flipped her off at one point.
sentences.zh: 曾有一个男子冲她比了个中指。

sentences.en: We asked them, do you know what is democracy?
sentences.zh: 我们问他们，你们知道什么是民主吗？

sentences.en: Do you have it in China?
sentences.zh: 中国有民主吗？

sentences.en: The democracy is not for sale.
sentences.zh: 民主是不能出卖的。

sentences.en: You can't buy it.
sentences.zh: 你买不到它。

sentences.en: Do you know what is democracy?
sentences.zh: 你知道什么是民主吗？

sentences.en: You have no idea.
sentences.zh: 你根本不知道。

sentences.en: So Chinese mainlanders are hostile to that message.
sentences.zh: 所以中国大陆人对这种信息抱有敌意。

sentences.en: They are hostile, and that's because in large part of this amazingly intense propaganda machine that exists in the mainland.
sentences.zh: 他们充满敌意，这在很大程度上是因为大陆存在着一套惊人强大的宣传机器。

sentences.en: You know, one thing that's caught on in the mainland is this idea that the protests are the work of America, that the CIA is backing them, that it's illegitimate,
sentences.zh: 你知道的，大陆现在流行的一种观点是，抗议活动是美国的阴谋，是中情局在背后支持，这是非法的，

sentences.en: that America is just trying to meddle in China's affairs and embarrass China.
sentences.zh: 美国只是在试图干涉中国内政并让中国难堪。

sentences.en: And a lot of people buy that.
sentences.zh: 很多人都相信这一点。

sentences.en: For a lot of them, they can't really believe that people would come out to protest just out of their own interests.
sentences.zh: 对他们中的许多人来说，他们真的无法相信人们会仅仅出于自身利益而出来抗议。

sentences.en: They believe that there must be somebody pushing them to do this, and that they are just pawns in this broader geopolitical war.
sentences.zh: 他们认为必定有人在背后指使他们这么做，而他们只是这场更大地缘政治战争中的棋子。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》App？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 免费解锁？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有的报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果能免费探索《时报》一个月，甚至不需要输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download The New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》App时，你在App里的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间可以突破付费墙，看看《时报》订户每天都能获取什么内容。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是《纽约时报》的订户，今天就下载《时报》App，获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: So, Javier, why would that be a plausible story to the people in China, this idea that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 那么，哈维尔，为什么这种说法对中国人民来说会是一个貌似有理的故事，也就是美国

sentences.en: is somehow behind what's happening in Hong Kong?
sentences.zh: 某种程度上在幕后操纵香港发生的事情？

sentences.en: Well, I live in Beijing, and so there's been this surge over the past year in anti-American propaganda, this attempt to pin all of China's problems on the United States.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我住在北京，所以在过去的一年里，反美宣传激增，这种试图将中国的所有问题都归咎于美国的企图。

sentences.en: Every time I'm in a taxi and news about America comes up on the radio, inevitably, the driver will turn back to me and ask, why is America trying to hold China back?
sentences.zh: 每次我坐出租车，收音机里播报关于美国的新闻时，司机总会回过头来问我，为什么美国总想阻挠中国的发展？

sentences.en: Why is America trying to stop China's rise?
sentences.zh: 为什么美国总想阻止中国的崛起？

sentences.en: And a large part of that is the trade war that has broken out between the Trump administration and China.
sentences.zh: 很大一部分原因在于特朗普政府与中国之间爆发的贸易战。

sentences.en: When I'm out and about talking to people, all they can say is, why now?
sentences.zh: 当我到处和人们交谈时，他们反复说的就是：为什么偏偏是现在？

sentences.en: Why would America try to do this?
sentences.zh: 美国为什么要这么做？

sentences.en: We're in our moment, our greatest moment.
sentences.zh: 我们正处于我们的高光时刻，我们最辉煌的时刻。

sentences.en: China has come out of poverty.
sentences.zh: 中国已经摆脱了贫困。

sentences.en: China is building its influence around the world.
sentences.zh: 中国正在世界各地建立自己的影响力。

sentences.en: Why would America try to undermine that right now?
sentences.zh: 为什么美国偏偏要在此时试图破坏这一切？

sentences.en: It must be because America thinks that it's losing its status as a superpower, and it's just angry about that.
sentences.zh: 那一定是因为美国觉得自己正在失去超级大国的地位，因而对此感到愤怒。

sentences.en: So in the middle of this trade war, in the middle of all this propaganda,
sentences.zh: 因此，在这场贸易战中，在所有这些宣传的中途，

sentences.en: the fact that this protest erupts in Hong Kong, if you're in mainland China, it all adds up to a sinister plot by the U.S.
sentences.zh: 香港爆发的这场抗议，如果你身处中国大陆，这一切都会汇聚成美国旨在破坏中国崛起的阴谋。

sentences.en: to undermine China's rise.
sentences.zh: 旨在破坏中国的崛起。

sentences.en: It all makes sense if you're a mainlander.
sentences.zh: 如果你是一个大陆人，这一切都说得通。

sentences.en: It's this sense that America has led revolutions in other places, and now it's China's turn.
sentences.zh: 这种感觉就像是美国曾在其他地方领导过革命，现在轮到中国了。

sentences.en: That now it's using Hong Kong to undermine China, and who knows what else?
sentences.zh: 现在它正在利用香港来破坏中国，谁知道还会干别的什么？

sentences.en: Maybe it's plotting some kind of revolution.
sentences.zh: 也许它在策划某种革命。

sentences.en: There's really this, I would almost call it, a national campaign to drive up patriotism, and specifically to defend Hong Kong against what they see as this foreign threat.
sentences.zh: 这确实——我甚至称之为一场旨在激发爱国主义、特别是保护香港免受他们所认为的这种外部威胁侵害的国家行动。

sentences.en: And did you see evidence in the airport that this is working?
sentences.zh: 你在机场有没有看到这招管用的证据？

sentences.en: I did.
sentences.zh: 我看到了。

sentences.en: Hi.
sentences.zh: 嗨。

sentences.en: I was here yesterday.
sentences.zh: 我昨天来过这里。

sentences.en: I was trying to reclaim a bag that I had checked before all this chaos broke out.
sentences.zh: 我当时想拿回在所有这些混乱爆发前托运的一个包。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Where do I go?
sentences.zh: 我该去哪？

sentences.en: And so I went to the airline desk, and of course there were dozens and dozens of mainlanders who were also heading back to Beijing.
sentences.zh: 于是我去了航空公司柜台，当然那里有几十名同样要返回北京的大陆人。

sentences.en: In Beijing, are you習慣嗎?
sentences.zh: 在北京，你们习惯吗？

sentences.en: 習慣了,對,對.
sentences.zh: 习惯了，对，对。

sentences.en: 空隙污染的問題.
sentences.zh: 关于空气污染的问题。

sentences.en: And so we got to chatting a little bit, and these two friends from Sichuan province started to talk to me about how they saw the protests.
sentences.zh: 于是我们闲聊了起来，这两个来自四川的朋友开始跟我聊起他们对这场抗议的看法。

sentences.en: And they felt like nothing like this could ever happen in China.
sentences.zh: 他们觉得在中国绝不可能发生这种事。

sentences.en: Hong Kong was unruly, and that it must be some foreign force that had tried to bring this against China as a way to destabilize the country.
sentences.zh: 香港太无法无天了，这必定是某种外国势力试图以此来对付中国，作为动摇国家的一种方式。

sentences.en: And so you really hear, just talking to mainlanders, they almost pull these points out from the exact same places.
sentences.zh: 所以你真的会发现，只要跟大陆人交谈，他们几乎能从完全相同的地方搬出这些论点。

sentences.en: They speak in the same terms about foreign influence and hostile foreign forces.
sentences.zh: 他们用同样的措辞来谈论境外影响和敌对外国势力。

sentences.en: And it's kind of the same message that shows the effectiveness, really, of the Chinese propaganda machine.
sentences.zh: 这可以说是同样的讯息，真正展现了中国宣传机器的有效性。

sentences.en: And the goal is really to just create doubts about information, what can be trusted and what can't, what's real and what's not.
sentences.zh: 而其真正的目标，就是对信息制造怀疑，分不清什么可信什么不可信，什么是真什么是假。

sentences.en: But beyond what's happening here with Hong Kong, it sounds like the people of China may really accept the idea that democracy is not a better system
sentences.zh: 但除了香港这里发生的事情之外，听起来中国人民可能真的接受了这样一种观念：民主并不是一个比

sentences.en: than the one that they have in the mainland.
sentences.zh: 他们在大陆所拥有的更好的系统。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: There's enormous pride in China's system, the sense that what the Communist Party has done has ensured stability and prosperity for so many Chinese.
sentences.zh: 中国体制内有着强烈的自豪感，人们普遍认为，共产党所做的事确保了广大中国人民的稳定与繁荣。

sentences.en: And so they're very reluctant to see or really engage with any other kind of system like democracy.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们非常抗拒看到或真正接触任何其他体制，比如民主体制。

sentences.en: For President Xi Jinping, he really believes in this too.
sentences.zh: 对习近平主席来说，他也坚信这一点。

sentences.en: I feel that he really doubts this idea that if you give more power, more voice to the people, that it will result in helping society.
sentences.zh: 我感觉他是真的怀疑这种说法，即赋予人民更多的权力、更多的话语权会有助于社会发展。

sentences.en: He thinks it could turn into chaos.
sentences.zh: 他认为这可能会演变成混乱。

sentences.en: People turn on each other.
sentences.zh: 人们会互相攻击。

sentences.en: And he's a guy who has spoken about the Soviet Union's collapse.
sentences.zh: 而且他是一个谈论过苏联解体的人。

sentences.en: And that's something that he, I think, keeps very front and center in his mind.
sentences.zh: 我认为，这件事一直被他深深地铭记在心。

sentences.en: The sense that the Soviet Union did not do enough to ensure ideological conformity.
sentences.zh: 苏联在确保思想一致性方面做得不够。

sentences.en: And he sees that as the root cause of the collapse of the Soviet Union.
sentences.zh: 他将此视为苏联解体的根本原因。

sentences.en: And he's going to make sure that that doesn't happen in China.
sentences.zh: 他要确保这种情况不会在中国发生。

sentences.en: And he sees Hong Kong as perhaps a first step toward that unraveling.
sentences.zh: 他把香港或许视为这种瓦解的第一步。

sentences.en: So viewed from that perspective, it's in the best interest of not just mainland China, but of Hong Kong to get these protests under control.
sentences.zh: 所以从这个角度来看，控制住这些抗议活动，不仅最符合中国大陆的利益，也最符合香港的利益。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: In the party's view, it's now a time for national unity, not to be undermining China's rise and speaking against the Communist Party.
sentences.zh: 在党看来，现在是实现民族团结的时候，而不是破坏中国崛起、反对共产党的时候。

sentences.en: Inside the airport, the two camps really, I think, aren't hearing each other anymore.
sentences.zh: 我认为，在机场内部，这两个阵营确实已经听不进对方的声音了。

sentences.en: There's this sense that they're speaking past each other.
sentences.zh: 给人的感觉是他们根本无法沟通。

sentences.en: The protesters on the one side calling for democracy, the mainlanders coming from this propaganda perspective of thinking this is a conspiracy.
sentences.zh: 一方面是呼吁民主的抗议者，另一方面则是带着宣传视角、认为这是一场阴谋的大陆人。

sentences.en: And it's this symbol of these two different Chinas and a sense of the irreconcilable differences.
sentences.zh: 这就是这两种截然不同的中国的象征，也体现了那些不可调和的分歧。

sentences.en: And nobody seems to be willing to give an inch to move any closer to each other.
sentences.zh: 似乎没有人愿意退让一步，向对方靠拢。

sentences.en: Because how can you when it's a battle over democracy versus authoritarian communism?
sentences.zh: 因为当这是一场民主与威权共产主义的较量时，你又怎么能退让呢？

sentences.en: Essentially, those are irreconcilable.
sentences.zh: 从本质上讲，这些是不可调和的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And it goes back to Hong Kong's handover to China in 1997.
sentences.zh: 这要追溯到1997年香港回归中国。

sentences.en: There was a sense that this was going to be a grand political experiment, that maybe there was a way to blend autocracy with these civil liberties.
sentences.zh: 当时人们有一种感觉，这将是一场宏大的政治实验，也许有一种方法可以将专制与这些公民自由融合在一起。

sentences.en: But I think what a lot of people are now thinking is maybe we were wrong.
sentences.zh: 但我想现在很多人都在想，也许我们错了。

sentences.en: Maybe there's not really a happy middle ground here.
sentences.zh: 也许这里根本没有什么皆大欢喜的中间立场。

sentences.en: Maybe there is no way to compromise.
sentences.zh: 也许根本没有妥协的余地。

sentences.en: So, with a divide that vast, where do you think that this goes from here, Javier?
sentences.zh: 那么，面对如此巨大的分歧，哈维尔，你认为接下来会走向何方？

sentences.en: Well, there's some speculation that it could get a lot worse, that Beijing would take military steps to control the protests.
sentences.zh: 嗯，有一些猜测认为情况可能会变得更糟，北京会采取军事手段来控制抗议活动。

sentences.en: But many experts say that's still very unlikely.
sentences.zh: 但许多专家表示，这仍然不太可能。

sentences.en: They feel that
sentences.zh: 他们觉得

sentences.en: Beijing wouldn't want that kind of a reputational hit.
sentences.zh: 北京不会愿意承受那种声誉上的打击。

sentences.en: They don't want another
sentences.zh: 他们不希望再发生一次

sentences.en: Tiananmen Square incident where the world's decrying them for taking strong action against protesters.
sentences.zh: 天安门广场事件，招致全世界对他们采取强力手段镇压抗议者的谴责。

sentences.en: But there are a lot of other tools that China could use.
sentences.zh: 但中国还可以使用很多其他手段。

sentences.en: Things like punishing companies that work in the mainland.
sentences.zh: 比如惩罚在大陆运营的公司。

sentences.en: And the goal here is really to put these companies in the crosshairs.
sentences.zh: 这里的主要目的是将这些公司置于风口浪尖。

sentences.en: And is that a powerful enough lever, do you think, to make a difference?
sentences.zh: 你认为这会是一个足够强大的筹码，能够带来改变吗？

sentences.en: Well, already we're seeing it's making a difference.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们已经看到它正在发挥作用了。

sentences.en: A suspension of flight staff who joined illegal protests begins today.
sentences.zh: 今天开始停飞参与非法抗议的机组人员。

sentences.en: The Chinese government this week forced Cathay Pacific, this iconic Hong Kong airline, to prevent staffers or any employees who support or participate in these protests
sentences.zh: 本周，中国政府强迫香港标志性航空公司国泰航空，阻止其支持或参与这些抗议活动的职员或任何员工

sentences.en: from doing any work related to flights to mainland China.
sentences.zh: 从事任何飞往中国大陆航班相关的工作。

sentences.en: Shares in the firm slumped over 4% Monday.
sentences.zh: 该公司股价周一暴跌超过4%。

sentences.en: That after Beijing demanded that Cathay punish staff who attended the protests.
sentences.zh: 此前，北京要求国泰航空惩罚参加抗议的员工。

sentences.en: The firm moved fast to comply.
sentences.zh: 该公司迅速采取行动以示合规。

sentences.en: And I think what they're trying to do now is to lean on these members of the Hong Kong business community who share the value that's most important to the Communist Party,
sentences.zh: 我想他们现在试图做的是，向香港商界中赞同共产党最核心价值观的这些成员施压，

sentences.en: which is that economic prosperity must come above all else.
sentences.zh: 这个核心价值观就是经济繁荣必须高于一切。

sentences.en: They're hoping to set off this broader sense of fear among the business community in Hong Kong and to show them and remind them that if they want any access to the Chinese market,
sentences.zh: 他们希望在香港商界引发更广泛的恐惧感，向他们展示并提醒他们，如果他们想获得中国市场的准入，

sentences.en: they want to do any business in China, they're going to have to get their employees in line.
sentences.zh: 想在中国做生意，就必须约束好自己的员工。

sentences.en: That's kind of fascinating because in some ways that's a very capitalist approach to this crisis of protests for democracy.
sentences.zh: 这挺有意思的，因为在某种程度上，对于争取民主的抗议危机，这是一种非常资本主义的处理方式。

sentences.en: Yeah, in many ways
sentences.zh: 是的，在许多方面

sentences.en: China is using the tools of capitalism now and hoping that people will think about the market and not think about ideals.
sentences.zh: 中国现在正在使用资本主义的工具，希望人们考虑市场而不是理想。

sentences.en: And for a country that's run by the Communist Party, it represents this remarkable shift that we've seen play out over decades.
sentences.zh: 对于一个由共产党执政的国家来说，这代表了我们在几十年里见证的显著转变。

sentences.en: China cares more about money now than in some ways it cares about its own original ideals, the communist ideals that were behind the People's Republic when it was founded.
sentences.zh: 在某种程度上，现在的中国比以往更关心金钱，而不是它最初的理想，也就是中华人民共和国成立之初的共产主义理想。

sentences.en: Javier, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 哈维尔，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: Many of the protesters told me that they worry that
sentences.zh: 许多抗议者告诉我，他们担心

sentences.en: Beijing might escalate its crackdown.
sentences.zh: 北京可能会升级镇压行动。

sentences.en: But they also said, so what?
sentences.zh: 但他们也说，那又怎样？

sentences.en: They have nothing to lose.
sentences.zh: 他们没什么可失去的。

sentences.en: They're ready to fight this fight.
sentences.zh: 他们已经准备好战斗到底了。

sentences.en: And so for a lot of them I think they're just prepared for a battle that may stretch on for months or even years.
sentences.zh: 因此，我认为他们中的很多人已经做好了长期战斗的准备，这场战斗可能会持续数月甚至数年。

sentences.en: On Wednesday night, the airport protests turned violent as demonstrators attacked a man they accused of being a mainland
sentences.zh: 周三晚上，机场的抗议活动演变成暴力冲突，示威者袭击了一名男子，指控他是冒充抗议者的中国大陆

sentences.en: Chinese police officer impersonating a protester.
sentences.zh: 警察。

sentences.en: Who are you?
sentences.zh: 你是谁？

sentences.en: I'm a touriSt.
sentences.zh: 我是一个游客。

sentences.en: I'm a touriSt.
sentences.zh: 我是一个游客。

sentences.en: You're wearing a sketch.
sentences.zh: 你穿着记者的衣服。

sentences.en: You're wearing a sketch.
sentences.zh: 你穿着记者的衣服。

sentences.en: You're wearing a sketch.
sentences.zh: 你穿着记者的衣服。

sentences.en: And later took a baton from another police officer and began to beat him with them.
sentences.zh: 随后，他们从另一名警察手中夺过警棍，开始殴打他。

sentences.en: The protesters eventually retreated after the officer pulled out his gun.
sentences.zh: 在警察拔出枪后，抗议者最终撤退了。

sentences.en: A few hours later,
sentences.zh: 几个小时后，

sentences.en: President Trump said on Twitter that U.S.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统在推特上表示，美国

sentences.en: intelligence agencies had learned that China was moving troops toward the border with Hong Kong.
sentences.zh: 情报机构获悉中国正在向香港边境调动军队。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他消息。

sentences.en: On Tuesday, the head of the
sentences.zh: 周二，杰弗里·爱泼斯坦

sentences.en: Manhattan Correctional Center where Jeffrey Epstein died, apparently by suicide, was reassigned and the two workers in charge of monitoring Epstein were placed on leave.
sentences.zh: 自杀身亡的曼哈顿惩教中心负责人被调职，负责监控爱泼斯坦的两名工作人员被停职。

sentences.en: The punishments were announced by the Justice Department after officials found that the jail had violated its own procedures by failing to check on Epstein for several hours
sentences.zh: 司法部在官员发现该监狱违反自身程序——连续几个小时未对爱泼斯坦进行查房，

sentences.en: and by leaving him alone without a cellmate just days after taking him off suicide watch.
sentences.zh: 并且在将其移出防自杀观察名单仅几天后就将其单独留在一个没有同室犯人的牢房里——之后宣布了这些惩罚措施。

sentences.en: The Times reports that the government of Venezuelan
sentences.zh: 《泰晤士报》报道称，委内瑞拉总统

sentences.en: President Nicolas Maduro has been imprisoning and torturing hundreds of soldiers in an attempt to keep the military loyal to his government.
sentences.zh: 尼古拉斯·马杜罗的政府一直在囚禁和折磨数百名士兵，以试图让军队效忠于他的政府。

sentences.en: The repressive tactics are Maduro's response to a series of attempted coups and assassinations since 2017 as Venezuela has descended into poverty, protest, and violence.
sentences.zh: 自2017年委内瑞拉陷入贫困、抗议和暴力以来，马杜罗面对一系列未遂政变和暗杀，采取了这些高压镇压手段。

sentences.en: The conduct violates Maduro's own pledge to end state-sponsored torture in Venezuela, which was widely used by his predecessors.
sentences.zh: 这一行径违背了马杜罗此前关于结束委内瑞拉由国家资助的酷刑的承诺，这种酷刑曾被他的前任们广泛使用。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日简报》的内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine until this summer
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受严密控制的机器在运作，直到今年夏天

sentences.en: when elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 选举迎来了宪章中自称的改革派。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直陷入一场残酷、混乱有时又令人兴奋的斗争中。

sentences.zh: 将为您讲述人们试图维持其影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.zh: 《都市》。
